title: Stock Market Today: Dow Ends 5-Day Win Streak, SanDisk -6.8%, AppLovin -19.7%; Hormuz Deal in Focus
summary: Dow fell 464 pts (-0.85%) to 53,885 on Aug 7, S&P500 -0.18% to 7,710, Nasdaq -0.06%. SanDisk sank 6.8% on guidance concerns (two-thirds of revenue growth price-driven), AppLovin -19.7% on Q2 revenue miss, Western Digital -13%. Markets awaiting Hormuz Strait reopening agreement and digesting heavy earnings season.
why: 美股整体回调，SanDisk暴跌6.8%（存储芯片估值担忧）、AppLovin -19.7%（Q2 miss），对隐波和sell put期权策略均为提示信号；霍尔木兹局势若持续升级可能带来更广泛风险偏好下行。

title: Trump Signs Executive Order Imposing 15% Tariff and Price Floors on Polysilicon; Effective Dec 4
summary: President Trump signed an executive order Aug 6 imposing a 15% tariff on polysilicon imports and minimum import prices (1/kg polysilicon, 00/kg ingots/wafers). The measures also cover solar cells and modules and take effect Dec 4, targeting China's near-monopoly on polysilicon production.
why: 多晶硅关税将影响太阳能供应链成本（全球光伏企业需承压）及半导体原材料，同时推高能源板块通胀预期；对美联储利率路径（偏鹰）有潜在影响，期权卖方需留意宏观层面通胀风险溢价抬升。

title: Airbnb Q2 2026 Earnings Surprise: Revenue .61B Beats, EPS .37 vs .25 Expected; Stock +9% After Hours
summary: Airbnb reported Q2 2026 EPS of .37 (est. .25), revenue .61B (+17% YoY, est. .58B). Net income rose to 16M; free cash flow +30% to .25B. Q3 guidance .69-4.77B (above .61B consensus). Stock jumped 9% in extended trading.
why: 科技成长股财报季整体偏强，Airbnb超预期打压隐波，若持仓类似增长股的covered call可关注展期机会；旅游复苏继续支持携程赛道逻辑。

title: Cloudflare Posts Q2 2026 Beat, Lifts Full-Year Outlook Amid AI Adoption; Stock +15%
summary: Cloudflare Q2 2026: adjusted EPS /bin/bash.29 (est. /bin/bash.27), revenue 96M (est. 65M). Full-year 2026 revenue guidance raised to .864-2.870B (from .805-2.813B). FY adjusted EPS raised to .25-1.26 (from .19-1.20). Stock initially rose ~15%.
why: AI驱动的云安全/网络加速需求持续超预期，佐证科技赛道中期逻辑；Cloudflare与持仓谷歌云、腾讯云赛道同向，整体利好科技长仓估值。

title: Palantir Q2 2026: Revenue +93% YoY to .94B, US Commercial +149%; CEO Calls Quarter 'Otherworldly'
summary: Palantir Q2 2026: revenue .94B (est. .81B), adj. EPS /bin/bash.41 (est. /bin/bash.35). US commercial revenue 64M (+149% YoY), US government 09M (+90% YoY). Full-year 2026 guidance raised to .15-8.16B (82% YoY). Stock surged ~30% in post-earnings session.
why: 政府AI平台需求爆发是本轮美股科技超预期的核心叙事，支持AIP/Foundry类AI平台估值重估；同步信号适用于评估Alphabet、英伟达等AI基础设施长仓持有逻辑；股价+30%使隐波急升，sell put需谨慎。

title: 腾讯控股（00700.HK）Q2 2026业绩将于8月12日（周三）收市后发布
summary: 腾讯控股宣布将于2026年8月12日收市后发布第二季度业绩，市场预期每股收益约.08、营收约98亿。核心业务（游戏、广告、金融科技）稳健增长背景下，AI货币化进展为关键观察点。
why: 腾讯0700.HK是核心港股持仓，业绩日（8月12日）前后为sell put/covered call的关键时间窗口；AI变现是估值重估催化剂，需提前关注期权隐含波动率变化。

title: Disney Q3 FY2026: EPS .06 Beats, Parks +10%, Streaming +11%; Share Buyback Target Raised to B
summary: Disney Q3 2026: EPS .06 (est. .88), revenue 5.25B (slight miss vs 5.66B est.). Parks & Experiences +10% YoY to .97B; Entertainment streaming +11% to .53B. Buyback target raised to B (from B) on A+E stake sale proceeds (~.2B cash).
why: 迪士尼DIS乐园和流媒体双强，EPS超预期支持估值，回购加力利好股东回报；对比持仓逻辑，利好消费及娱乐赛道整体情绪。

title: Circle (CRCL) Q2 2026: EPS 18¢ Beats Estimates, USDC Supply +19% to 3.3B; OCC National Trust Bank Approved; Morgan Stanley Cuts to 8
summary: Circle Q2 2026 revenue 01M (vs 13M est.), adj. EPS /bin/bash.18 (beat /bin/bash.16). USDC supply 3.3B (+19% YoY), on-chain transfer volume 4.8T (+150%). OCC approved Circle National Trust, enabling federally regulated digital asset custody. Morgan Stanley (Aug 3) downgraded to Underweight, PT 8 (from 06). TD Cowen initiated Buy at 2.
why: Circle稳定币业务与美国稳定币立法进展（GENIUS Act）高度绑定；MS下调目标价至8相较TD Cowen的2 Buy形成极度分歧，反映市场对USDC长期增长路径的争议；若持有CRCL sell put仓位需特别注意下行风险。

title: SanDisk Q4 FY2026: Revenue .97B (+372% YoY), 10 Agreements Worth 3.9B; Stock -6.8% Aug 7 on Guidance Quality Concerns
summary: SanDisk Q4 FY2026 revenue .97B (+372% YoY, +51% QoQ), FY2026 full-year revenue 0.25B (+175% YoY). Q1 FY2027 guidance: revenue 0.3-10.8B, EPS 4-46. Company signed 10 new deals worth min 3.9B with 4+ year visibility. However, stock fell 6.8% Aug 7 as mgmt noted ~2/3 of revenue growth came from price increases vs. 1/3 volume growth — raising sustainability concerns.
why: 闪迪SNDK业绩数字极强但靠涨价支撑，量少价多模式市场担忧可持续性；8月7日-6.8%股价反应是内存超级周期下的估值重置信号，与持仓美光（MU）及SK海力士逻辑相关，需警惕存储板块供给回升后的定价逆转。

title: McDonald's Q2 2026: U.S. Sales Miss Expectations; Appoints New U.S. President, CEO Admits Execution Shortfall
summary: McDonald's Q2 2026 showed mixed results with U.S. performance missing targets. CEO Kempczinski acknowledged 'We simply didn't execute at the level we needed to.' Company appointed Skye Anderson as new president of U.S. business.
why: 麦当劳美国业务持续承压（消费降级/客流疲软），与海底捞、蜜雪冰城等餐饮持仓的竞争格局分析相关；餐饮板块整体消费情绪参考。

title: 小米汽车8月购车权益发布：SU7/YU7现车享3年0息或6000元保险补贴，最快2小时提车
summary: 小米汽车发布2026年8月购车政策：现车用户可享3年0息金融方案或6000元保险补贴（二选一），最快2小时提车。SU7系列最高权益至4.2万元（Max版6.1万元），YU7系列最高至7.9万元（GT版）。科技舒享套装限时降价7000元（原价1.5万元）。小米SU7/YU7累计交付超70万辆。
why: 雷军亲自发布8月购车政策是维持销量的重要信号；累计70万辆交付彰显市场地位；持有1810.HK的投资者可关注月度交付数据对股价催化。
